description: Unit tests for validating XML configuration files against a DTD for module configuration in OpenMRS, specifically focusing on version 1.2 compatibility.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_2
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating module configuration XML files against a DTD, focusing on version 1.2 support and validating various filter and filter mapping configurations.

methods.name: filterWithAllValuesSet
methods.description: Tests that a configuration XML with all required filter attributes set is valid.

methods.name: filterValidWithoutInitParams
methods.description: Checks validity when init parameters are missing optional names.

methods.name: filterInvalidWhenMissingFilterName
methods.description: Asserts invalidity when filter name is missing.

methods.name: filterInvalidWhenMissingFilterClass
methods.description: Asserts invalidity when filter class is missing.

methods.name: filterInvalidWithInitParamNameMissing
methods.description: Validates that missing init param name results in valid XML.

methods.name: filterInvalidWithInitParamValueMissing
methods.description: Ensures XML is invalid when an init param value is missing.

methods.name: filterMappingWithUrlPattern
methods.description: Tests valid filter mapping with URL pattern.

methods.name: filterMappingWithServletName
methods.description: Tests valid filter mapping with servlet name.

methods.name: filterMappingWithBothUrlPatternAndServletNameFails
methods.description: Checks that specifying both URL pattern and servlet name invalidates the configuration.

methods.name: filterMappingWithNeitherUrlPatternOrServletNameFails
methods.description: Ensures invalidity when neither URL pattern nor servlet name are specified.
